The system shall maintain an audit log of all access and modifications to attendance records.
The system shall encrypt all student attendance data at rest and in transit.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records after successful authentication.
The system shall generate attendance reports including anonymized data to protect student identities.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for at least five years.
The system shall ensure real-time processing of attendance data.
The system shall implement automated alerts for significant discrepancies in attendance reporting.
The system shall implement efficient algorithms to minimize overall energy consumption during data processing.
The system shall support at least 500 concurrent users without performance degradation.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process.
